tracks.name: RUSTED BELL TOLL
tracks.tags: experimental doom dirge in a funereal slow tempo, built around a lone triangle carrying harsh dissonant strikes and hanging over empty low-end pulse. the arrangement opens bare and punishing, then thickens with sub-bass drones, distant tom hits, and a crushing midsection pause before the final toll returns solo. sparse processed breaths, metallic decay tails, reverse swells into each hit, and a cold cathedral-like reverb wash. dark, , and shockingly clear mix., slow

tracks.name: HEY SAX MAN
tracks.tags: funk-rock with a swaggering midtempo backbeat, clipped guitar skanks, punchy bass, and a spotlight sax lead that answers the vocals verse rides lean and taunting, pre-chorus strips to handclaps and a rising shout, chorus hits with gang chants and brassy stabs, then a sax break takes center stage before the final hook. lead vocal is gritty and close-mic with shouted doubles on the title, call-and-response ad-libs, tape delay throws on key exclamations, and a bright, wide mix with little room-echo tails and a quick horn riser into each drop., saxophone

tracks.name: CLOCKWORK ORBIT
tracks.tags: experimental electronic with theremin lead, electric arpeggio runs, and a counterpoint-heavy chamber structure at a brisk, flowing tempo intro opens on solo theremin and glassy pulse, verse-like passages stack arpeggios, the middle section blooms into harmonic solfege canon and four-part fugue entries, then a climactic solo break lets the theremin soar over interlocking lines. filigree risers, reverse swells, and delayed chime accents bridge each handoff. clean, wide, cerebral mix with bright stereo shimmer and precise separation., electric

tracks.name: SLIPPY SLOOPY FROG
tracks.tags: hard bop jazz instrumental with a loose atempo feel, walking bass implied then intentionally fractured into slippy dissonant sax bursts head section starts sparse with brushed snare taps and piano shell voicings, solo sections open into roving tenor phrases over shifting cymbal accents, then a brief drop to near-silence before the final chorus of horn squawks. tape hiss, breath pops, and a sudden stop-start piano tag add ear candy dry front-loaded mix, smoky and close-mic with raw club-room punch, saxophone, hard bop

tracks.name: PIZZA STONE BLOW
tracks.tags: hard bop jazz in a feverish mid-tempo swing that keeps slipping into atempo half-bursts sax leads the front line while brushes crackle under piano clusters and bass pops. verse feel is loose and smoky, the break strips to solo horn and empty space, then the head returns with louder hits and shouted ensemble accents. close, live room mix bright brass, dusty drums, and hot piano bite with tape-edge grit., saxophone, hard bop, soft, loud

tracks.name: SLOW PHASE BUMP
tracks.tags: synth-pop with a slow pulse and loping four-on-the-floor bump, centered on a lonely theremin lead that drifts in one-note phrases and phase-shifted swells. verse-like intro stays bare with kick, muted bass, and filtered handclaps middle section widens with detuned pads and tape wobble final lift adds octave bass movement and ghostly reverb tails. intimate, glossy, hypnotic mix with airy top end and warm low-end throb., pop, slow

tracks.name: BLUE GLASS SPIRAL
tracks.tags: jazz instrumental in a moderato swing feel, with brushed drums, walking bass, hammond organ comping in warm swells, and a theremin lead that bends around the changes. verse-like head states the melody, then a loose solo exchange opens the groove, organ answering theremin phrases and trading fours with the kit. ribbon glides, tape echo flickers, and a soft room-tone tail keep it intimate, smoky, and wide in the mix., jazz

tracks.name: SELTZER KEY CHANGE
tracks.tags: free jazz with hard bop swing and downtempo pulse, syncopated drum conversation, electric organ comping, filthy tenor sax lead, harmonica fades, and experimental prog key shifts. intro creeps in from a lone organ drone verse section opens the pocket with clipped drums middle break lets sax and organ trade jagged lines final section stretches into party chaos. gritty, wide, and live-room raw., electric, downtempo, hard bop, saxophone, free jazz, swing, experimental

tracks.name: PIZZA STONE BOP
tracks.tags: hard bop jazz with a loose atempo swing feel, slippy horn phrasing, brushed drums that snap from soft ride to loud accents, and a piano comp that kicks dissonant clusters under the sax lead verse-like head rides sparse bass and brush whisper, middle breaks to empty space and frog-bop motifs, then the final pass gets fuller with oomphing hits and hot pizzicato stabs. close-mic sax, smoky room bleed, bright bite on the top and a gritty, old-club mix with punchy transients., hard bop, saxophone, loud, soft

tracks.name: FROG BOP
tracks.tags: hard bop jazz with atempo rubato phrasing, sly swing-to-free movement, brushed drums snapping into sudden loud accents, upright bass walking under dissonant tenor sax runs, then the groove loosens into slippy, sloopy fills and breathy pauses. verse-like head rides sparse brushes middle break opens into empty space and tense sax cries final pass snaps back with sharper drum hits and a bluesy lift. close-room mono sax tone, warm tape grit, punchy mids, smoky club mix, loud, saxophone, hard bop, soft

tracks.name: FUGUE OF SOLFEGE
tracks.tags: classical acappella with theremin-like lead phrasing, intricate four-part canon, and brisk arpeggiated vocal runs verse layers enter one by one in imitation, pre-chorus tightens into clipped solfege figures, chorus blooms in stacked harmony with ring-modulated lead-like phrasing, and a brief bridge opens into a solo spotlight before the final fugue. close-mic voices with precise double-tracked unisons, panned inner parts, and airy hall reverb featured ear candy includes reversed breath swells, rising chime pickups, and a soft tape flutter between entries. bright, lucid, and theatrical mix., electric

tracks.name: GHOST COIL
tracks.tags: electro-pop instrumental built around eerie theremin lead lines over pulsing analog bass and crisp four-on-the-floor drums verse section stays sparse with tape hiss and filtered synth bed, pre-drop adds rising noise and arpeggiated bell pings, main drop hits with stacked handclap accents and octave bass movement, middle break strips to solo theremin and sub hits before the final lift. bright, glossy, wide mix with a haunted vintage shimmer.

tracks.name: EMPTY CLUB CHAIR
tracks.tags: hard bop jazz with atempo shifts, slinky walking bass, cracked ride cymbal, and brusque brushwork sax solo leads over dissonant piano clusters, verse-like head states the theme, then a lean breakdown strips to drums and bass before the final chorus-like reprise with louder horn cries and abrupt hits. whisper-close horn tone, smoky room ambience, clipped shout accents, tape hiss turnarounds, and a punchy midrange mix with gritty horn bite., hard bop, soft, loud, saxophone

tracks.name: SELTZER SPIRAL
tracks.tags: experimental prog with lurching odd-meter drums, electric organ swells, biting saxophone leads, and a walking bass pulse that keeps shifting under the groove verse-like sections open on organ and drums, the middle stretches into a sax-and-organ duel, then the final passage jumps into a bright key change for a bigger party lift. razor-clean transient hits, tape-flutter transitions, sudden stop-time breaks, and a wide live-room mix with glossy top-end sparkle., electric, experimental, saxophone

tracks.name: PHANTOM THEREMIN

tracks.name: HOPPER PIPER
tracks.tags: pop-rap with bouncy swung drums and a rubbery synth bass verse rides sparse handclaps and a snapping pluck, pre-chorus strips to filtered percussion and a rising vocal stack, chorus lands with punchy drums, gang vowels, and a repeating chant hook. add reversed risers into the hook, tiny bell flicks between lines, and a sidechain pump on the bass. bright, clean, and playful with glossy top-end.

tracks.name: FIDDLE NO NOW
tracks.tags: funky pop with bouncy offbeat guitar, punchy kick-snare, and a rubbery bassline verse stays sparse with clipped vocal phrases and handclap snaps, pre-chorus lifts with filtered backing chants and a rising synth smear, chorus opens into stacked doubles and a chantable hook, bridge drops to half-time with a single bass pulse before the final chorus. bright, glossy mix with crisp transients, playful ear candy, and short delay throws on the last word of each hook.

tracks.name: PHASER ON 200A
tracks.tags: jazz-fusion instrumental with relaxed swung 84 bpm, heavy shuffle triplet feel, greasy half-time pocket and slow-blooming intensity. intro starts on smoky wurlitzer vamp build adds blues phrases, side-slips, and echo tails solo peaks with bebop bursts, outside lines, and drummer ride-cymbal fills outro settles on a turnaround vamp. close room-mic warmth, grainy analog saturation, phaser sweep, slapback tape echo, dry and alive., gospel, dynamics, soul, deep, warm, electric, bebop, saturated, soulful, tone, funk, swing, classic, slow, jazz

tracks.name: LESLIE FIREWALK
tracks.tags: gospel-prog hammond organ showcase at accelerating 110 to 168 bpm, driven by thunderous left-hand pedal bass, blistering right-hand runs, glissando smears, and cluster chord hits intro opens in smoky church-revival rubato, verse-like passages stay sparse around bass pedals and modal comping, then the arrangement surges into double-time barrelhouse frenzy with key lifts by minor thirds and rotor speed ramps from slow chorale to fast tremolo at each climax. pristine close rotary capture, tube saturation, spring reverb blooms, expression-pedal swells, and explosive crowd energy, wide and face-melting, soulful, transcendent, bebop, slow, gospel, dynamic, rapid
